Kate — great questions. Short answers up front, then a proposed action list for the MAP to close out perf validation.

Short answers:
- 256-token contexts (end-to-end generation): P50 = 112ms, P95 = 420ms (staging, no prefix cache priming). Drop in tail latency primarily due to KV lookup growth and memory copy overhead at that length.
- The snapshot attached earlier was run with prefix caching disabled to simulate cold-starts. We have additional runs with prefix/KV cache enabled (improves P95 by ~30-40% at longer contexts).
- Quantization: we bench'd a 4-bit static quant profile (q4_0) for the candidate model. Quality spot-checks on your eval set show negligible latency-visible regressions on accuracy metrics (ROUGE/QA pass) for 90% of prompts; 10% show slight tokenization artifacts on rare unicode sequences. We'll include more evals in the MAP.

Detailed numbers (staging, cand-v2, 8 workers):
- 32 tokens: P50 38ms / P95 122ms / throughput 90 reqs/sec
- 128 tokens: P50 74ms / P95 245ms / throughput 72 reqs/sec
- 256 tokens: P50 112ms / P95 420ms / throughput 58 reqs/sec
- With KV cache (warm): 256 tokens P95 ~ 270ms (approx -35%)

Proposed actions (for the MAP -> owners -> due dates):
1) Run 256-token full-eval on customer prompts (3 replicate runs, include unicode edge cases) — owner: Monica Patel — due: 2028-03-16
2) Run quantized (q4_0) A/B on the Acme eval set, record quality deltas & generate examples for the MAP review — owner: Rishi Malhotra — due: 2028-03-19
3) Run concurrency stress test at 150 reqs/sec sustained for 15m (measure P99 and error rate), capture resource utilization — owner: Aisha Rahman — due: 2028-03-16 (we'll run during Tuesday window)
4) Procurement readiness: share draft SOW + SLA items (Redwood legal will send) — owner: procurement@redwood.com — due: 2028-03-18

I'll bring the warm-cache vs cold-cache graphs and at least one q4_0 vs baseline diff file to the Tuesday call. If anything in the above looks off for your team, say so and we'll adjust.

See you Tuesday 11:00 PT — joining link in calendar invite.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
